title: Measurement-Driven Adaptive Low-Overhead Implementation of Multi-Controlled Toffoli Gates
summary: The Toffoli gate is a fundamental building block for quantum arithmetic and reversible logic, yet its efficient realization remains a major challenge in both near-term and fault-tolerant quantum architectures. Recent advances in dynamic quantum circuit capabilities, including mid-circuit measurement and classical feedforward, provide new opportunities for reducing the resource overhead of non-Clifford operations.
